scripts.prepare:build: mkdir -p core/frontend/lib/locales core/backend/src/common/config core/backend/src/scripts/tools && rm -rf core/frontend/lib/locales/backend && cp locales/ro.json locales/ru.json locales/en.json core/frontend/lib/locales/ && cp locales/backend/*.json core/backend/src/common/i18n/ && cp -r theme core/frontend/lib/ && rm -rf core/frontend/lib/config && cp -r config core/frontend/lib/ && cp config/parsers.ts core/backend/src/common/config/parsers.ts && cp -r parsers/* core/backend/src/scripts/tools/ && cp -r assets/frontend/public/* core/frontend/public/ && cp -r assets/backend/watermark core/backend/assets/ && TS_NODE_PROJECT=core/frontend/tsconfig.json node -r ts-node/register core/frontend/scripts/write-theme-json.js
scripts.build: npm run prepare:build && cd core/frontend && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:build && cd core && npm run dev
scripts.seed: COUNTRY=md npm run prepare:build && cd core/backend && COUNTRY=md npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/stage/seed.ts
scripts.reset-and-seed: COUNTRY=md npm run prepare:build && cd core/backend && COUNTRY=md npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/stage/reset-and-seed.ts
scripts.add-brands: cd core/backend && npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/stage/add-brands.ts
scripts.seed-all-brands: cd core/backend && npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/stage/seed-all-brands.ts
scripts.check-models-validity: cd core/backend && COUNTRY=md npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/stage/check-models-validity.ts
scripts.release-check: env -u devdir sh -c 'npm run prepare:build && (cd core/frontend && npm run lint && npm run lint:styles && npm run format:check && npm test -- --passWithNoTests && npm run build) && (cd core/backend && npm run lint:check && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run build)'
